This is not sandboxed and violates the preview isolation requirement.
- **Blocker — occurrence race/idempotency:** `packages/backend/src/campaign/campaign.repository.ts:361-420` creates a run after read checks, while `packages/database/prisma/migrations/20260722120000_campaigns_and_scheduling/migration.sql:220-224` creates only non-unique indexes. - **Blocker — preview security:** `apps/next-app/src/lib/catalog-preview.ts:22-44,91-92` injects sanitized catalog HTML directly into the application document. `<style>` elements are not removed, so imported/hostile catalog markup can apply global CSS (including `@import`/external `url()` fetches) outside the preview host; `srcset` and legacy `background` URL attributes are also unfiltered. This is not sandboxed and violates the preview isolation requirement.
- **Blocker — occurrence race/idempotency:** `packages/backend/src/campaign/campaign.repository.ts:361-420` creates a run after read checks, while `packages/database/prisma/migrations/20260722120000_campaigns_and_scheduling/migration.sql:220-224` creates only non-unique indexes. Concurrent worker retries for the same schedule/source/occurrence can each materialize and send independent campaigns; no unique occurrence key or locking prevents it.
- **High — unavailable resources still materialize:** `packages/backend/src/campaign/campaign.repository.ts:384-405` loads source email/page/profile without requiring catalog visibility or active status, and only checks visibility—not `ACTIVE`—for the schedule target group. An archived/inactive dependency is copied into a new occurrence instead of marking the schedule broken as required.

Users cannot configure finite schedules, end dates, or disable/change auto-completion.
- **High — schedule editing is unavailable in the new UI:** `apps/next-app/app/(app)/(org)/schedule/[id]/page.tsx:7-52` is read-only and has no edit action/route; `apps/next-app/src/components/organisms/schedules/form-container.tsx:14-27` only creates schedules.
